content.text: kpɑ n bu bɛkiɑ,
sɑɑ yerɑ ben durum mɑɑ sɔ̃ɔsirɑ Sɑmɑriɔ.
Gbɛnɔbu bɑ dumɔ diɑɔ bɑ ɡbɛnimɔ.
Mɑ ben ɡɑbɑ yibɑ swɛɛ sɔɔ.
Adɑmɑ ben ɡoo sɑri wi u rɑ tii sɔ̃ u nɛɛ,
nɑ yɑɑye kɔ̃sɑ ye bɑ mɔ̀.
Tɛ̃, wee bɑ mwɑɑrɑ ben kom kɔ̃sum mɛ sɔɔ.
Nɑ ye kpuro wɑɑmɔ.
Ben nuku kɔ̃su kookoosu kɑ ben weesu
su sinɑ boko kɑ ben wiruɡibu nuku dobu wɛ̃ɛmɔ.
Be kpuro bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ sɑkɑrɑ kowobu bɑ sum
nɡe pɛ̃ɛ wɔ̃ɔ yeru te pɛ̃ɛ kowo u dɔ̃ɔ doke u deri.
Mɑ u dɑ u win pɛ̃ɛ som burɑ u yi sere mu kɑ se.
Bɑ̀ n ben sinɑ bokon tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru mɔ̀,
ben sinɑ ɑsɑkpɔbu kɑ sunɔn tii bɑ rɑ tɑm nɔwɑ
kpɑ bɑ n tɔmbu yɑɑ kɑsikimɔ.
Be bɑ rɑ nɔɔ tiɑ ko bu kɑ tɔmbu seesi,
bɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɡe pɛ̃ɛ wɔ̃ɔ yeru.
Wɔ̃kuru, ben wɔruɡɔru tɑ rɑ yɛmiɛwɑ
kpɑ yɑm sɑ̃re bururu tu se nɡe bɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu dɔ̃ɔ doke.
Be kpuro bɑ sumwɑ nɡe dɔ̃ɔ.
Bɑ rɑ ben kpɑrobu ɡowɑ
kpɑ ben sinɑmbu bɑ n wɔrukumɔ tiɑ tiɑ.
Adɑmɑ ben ɡoo ku rɑ mɑɑ mɑn somiru kɑnɛ.
Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ nɛɛ,
Isirelibɑ bɑ kɑ bwese tukunu mɛnnɑ.
Mɑ bɑ kuɑ nɡe kirɑ te bɑ ǹ ɡɔsie.
Bwese tuku ni, nu bu dɑm mwɑɑrimɔ.
Adɑmɑ bɑ ǹ yɛ̃ mɛ.
Tɔkɔrɑ bu deemɑmɔwɑ,
ɑdɑmɑ bɑ ǹ tubɑ.
Ben tii suɑbu sɔ̃ɔsirɑmɔ.
Domi bɑ ǹ ɡɔsirɑmɛ nɛ Gusunɔ ben Yinnin mi.
Kɑ yen de kpuro, bɑ ǹ mɑn kɑsu.
Bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe totobɛrɛ
te tɑ ǹ bwisi mɔ.
Bɑ Eɡibitiɡibu somiru kɑnɑmɔ,
mɑ bɑ dɑɑmɔ Asiriɔ.
Adɑmɑ bɑ̀ n swɑɑ wɔri nɑ rɑ bu tɑɑ bɛriewɑ
n bu mwɛɛri nɡe ɡunɔsu.
Kpɑ n bu sɛɛyɑsiɑ nɡe mɛ bɑ bu nɔɔsiɑ.
Bɑ kɑm kuɑwɑ mi, domi bɑ mɑn dukɑ suurimɔ.
Bɑ mɑn seesi, bɑ mɑn weesu kuɑ.
N deemɑ nɛnɑ kon dɑɑ bu fɑɑbɑ ko.
Bɑ̀ n mɑn somiru kɑnɑmɔ, bɑ ku rɑ tu ko ɡɔ̃ruɔ.
Adɑmɑ bɑ rɑ sinɛwɑ bɑ n tii muririmɔ.
Kpɑ bɑ n yĩiyɔ yeyɑ yɑ koo de ben ɡbeɑ yu ɑlikɑmɑ kɑ resɛm ɡeɑ mɑ.
Nɡe mɛyɑ bɑ rɑ n mɔ̀ bu kɑ mɑn seesi.
N deemɑ nɛnɑ nɑ bu nɔni doke nɑ bu dɑm wɛ̃.
Adɑmɑ kɑ mɛ, bɑ mɑn kɔ̃sɑ bwisikusimɔ.
Bɑ ɡɔsirɑ ɡoon mi ɡiɑ.
Bɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɡe tɛn te tɑ ǹ ɡeɑ sɑ̃ɑ.
Yen sɔ̃, bɑ koo ben wiruɡibu ɡo tɑbu sɔɔ
ben ɡɑri kɑm ɡerubun sɔ̃.
Yerɑ yɑ koo de bu bu yɛ̃ɛ Eɡibitiɔ.

content: Ye ɑ duurɑ yerɑ kɑɑ ɡɛ̃
